column1: # Immutable input manifest for the reversal-hunt 28t/31b volume calibration.
# calibrate.py verifies every sha256_gz before replaying and refuses to run on
# a mismatch. Files live on the NAS under
# and are read-only there; they are NOT committed (each is ~2-4 MB compressed,
# ~100-143 MB raw). `order` is the canonical file order within a session and is
# LOAD-BEARING: it supplies the file-index component of the total bucket key
# (eventTime, sequence, file index, line index), because `sequence` alone is the
# venue message sequence and is not unique. Changing `order` can change open/close
# in buckets whose edge trades share a venue sequence across partitions; the
# replay checks that sensitivity by re-running with the order reversed.
